rationale: C24 is a highly plausible drafting template. It uses essentially the same complete operative structure as the child: the same narrowed list of tax returns, a year range ending in 1959, applicability during the Eighty-sixth Congress, inspection by a Senate committee or authorized subcommittee, an investigative-purpose clause, compliance with Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133 approved May 3, 1955, and the same Federal Register effectiveness clause. The child principally substitutes a different Senate committee, investigation, resolution, and starting year. C11 and C25 are also close 1959 instances of the same template, but C24 is stronger because it likewise designates a Senate committee and uses the same committee-inspection formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1950 to 1959, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-sixth Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Agriculture and Forestry, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1947 to 1959, inclusive, shall, during the Eighty-sixth Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Government Operations, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.explanation: The operative sentence is nearly identical, with only the starting year and designated Senate committee changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in connection with its investigation of, and study of matters relating to, the operation of the Commodity Credit Corporation and other activities of the Department of Agriculture
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining the economy and efficiency of the Government
shared_material.explanation: Both insert the authorized committee investigation into the same position and grammatical machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, relating to the inspection of returns by committees of the Congress, approved by me on May 3, 1955
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, relating to the inspection of returns by committees of the Congress, approved by me on May 3, 1955
shared_material.explanation: This substantial administrative clause is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.explanation: The closing effectiveness provision differs only by the routine addition of “become.”
